usedFor: Agendor holds your deals and people, and viaSocket utilities adds a wait with “Pause Workflow” after “Deal Won”.

bestTemplate.name: “Deal Won” in Agendor, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A won deal starts the run, and the pause holds it for X minutes before the next step.

watchOut: “Update Deal” fires on every update, so one deal can start a run and its pause more than once.
